From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace co-sell: security evidence for CloudCore listing

Hi team,

CloudCore is moving toward listings on AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces and the respective partner teams have flagged that we need a consolidated evidence package for co-sell enablement. They want an itemized pack we can hand off to each marketplace: SOC 2 Type II attestation, a recent penetration test attestation/letter, signed DPA, network architecture diagram, and the standard security questionnaire (if available).

Can you each take ownership of one lane? Suggested split: Marissa — SOC2 and DPA (working with legal); Sergio — pen test letter and network diagram; I will compile the package, get the final README for the marketplaces, and submit to the partner contacts.

Target: have a submission-ready bundle by Monday 12/1 so we can hit the co-sell enablement window for CloudCore.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

---

From: Emily (AWS Marketplace) <emily@aws-marketplace.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: security evidence for CloudCore listing

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. For AWS co-sell we typically need the following as separate files:
- SOC2 Type II report (most current year)
- Penetration test attestation (letter on vendor letterhead)
- Executed DPA (PDF)
- Network diagram (Visio/PDF)
- Answers to our security questionnaire (we can accept a spreadsheet)

Also include a contact who can answer follow-up technical questions. If you can upload to a shared Drive and send the link, I’ll route it to our security review team.

Emily
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
emily@aws-marketplace.com
